meta.getChangelog: Schema rejects ESI's body: MetaChangelogSchema is the per-date map, but ESI (MetaChangelog) wraps it as { changelog: { <date>: [...] } }, so every real call throws EsiValidationError. Fixing it changes the inferred MetaChangelog type (major per guides/SEMVER.md), so it needs approval.
skyhook.getRaidableSkyhooks: Schema rejects ESI's body: the endpoint expects an array of RaidableSkyhook, but ESI (SkyhooksRaidable) sends { skyhooks: [...] }, so every real call throws EsiValidationError. Fixing it changes the method's return type (major per guides/SEMVER.md), so it needs approval.
